definitions.explanation: A head male servant who manages a household or estate. In modern Japanese, also associated with butler-themed cafes and anime/manga characters portraying elegant male servants.

examples.japanese: {執事|しつじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けた→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
{執事|しつじ}⟦{喫茶|きっさ}→喫茶：28984_kissa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I had tea at a butler cafe.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{屋敷|やしき}→屋敷：12395_yashiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{仕|つか}えて→仕える：11547_tsukaeru⟧きた{執事|しつじ}がいて、⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: The mansion has a butler who has served for many years and knows everything about the household.

notes:
USAGE:
Traditionally refers to the head servant of a wealthy household, especially in Western-style estates. In modern pop culture, {執事|しつじ} has become a popular character archetype in anime, manga, and games (e.g., "Black Butler" / {黒執事|くろしつじ}). {執事|しつじ}⟦{喫茶|きっさ}→喫茶：28984_kissa⟧ (butler cafes) are themed cafes where staff dress and act as butlers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {執事|しつじ}⟦{喫茶|きっさ}→喫茶：28984_kissa⟧: butler cafe
- ⟦{忠実|ちゅうじつ}→忠実：12570_chuujitsu⟧な{執事|しつじ}: faithful butler
- {執事|しつじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕|つか}える→仕える：11547_tsukaeru⟧: to serve as a butler
- {黒執事|くろしつじ}: Black Butler (popular manga/anime)
